[You can access the lab's private Shiny app via this link](https://private-vermeerlab.cmaslard.xyz/). Access is restricted (Cloudflare Access). Use your authorized email to receive a one-time login code. If you don't receive a code within \~60 seconds, your email is likely not allow-listed; please contact me.

This portal centralizes shared Shiny tools and resources used by the VermeerLab.
